subject: advanced-maths
title: Advanced Maths — Final Exam
note: Four problems of 2.5 points, one per block of the course (ODE, system, Fourier/Sturm-Liouville, PDE), as in the finals of 2019 and 2020 (2.5 points each). The papers print 3 to 4 hours; 3 hours is the standard here.

provenance.structure_source: Read from MATHS_FINALEXAM_2019_ORD (4 h), 2020_ORD (3.5 h), 2021_ORD_SOL (3.5 h), 2022_EXTRA (3 h) and 2024_ORD in sources/cuatrimestre-1/04-advanced-maths/examenes/: four problems that cover the whole course, 2.5 points each in 2019 and 2020 (2+3+3+2 in 2021 and 2022).
provenance.verify_when: The official duration of the current course's final exam is confirmed; update this file and drop this note.

content_scope_source: The whole course: second-order ODEs, systems of ODEs, Fourier series and Sturm-Liouville problems, and PDEs.

parts.label: Problem 1 — Second-order ODE
parts.description: A second-order linear equation: reduction of order, Cauchy-Euler or constant coefficients with forcing.

parts.label: Problem 2 — System of ODEs
parts.description: A linear or nonlinear planar system with its phase portrait.

parts.label: Problem 3 — Fourier and Sturm-Liouville
parts.description: A Fourier series with convergence, or an eigenvalue problem with its orthogonality.

parts.label: Problem 4 — PDE
parts.description: The heat, wave or Laplace equation by separation of variables.
